title.zh: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
title.en: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】

current_state.zh: tBTC 铸造和赎回仍暂停，但资产仍有足额 BTC 支持，未发现未经授权的铸币、比特币转移或资金损失；节点运营商正在修补或离线，跨链桥将在安全维护完成且节点在已修补系统上恢复运行后重新开放。
current_state.en: tBTC minting and redemption remain paused, but tBTC remains fully BTC-backed with no unauthorized minting, Bitcoin transfers, or fund loss found; node operators are patching or offline, and the bridge will reopen after security maintenance is completed and nodes resume on patched systems.

updates.title_zh: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
updates.title_en: 【Threshold：tBTC 全额抵押，新存款、铸造和赎回仍处于暂停状态】
updates.what_changed_zh: Threshold Network报告称，tBTC仍保持全额抵押，没有未经授权的铸造或损失，但为进行跨链安全维护，新存款、铸造和赎回已暂停，而以太坊和L2上的转账仍在继续。
updates.what_changed_en: Threshold Network reported that tBTC remains fully collateralized with no unauthorized minting or losses, but new deposits, minting, and redemptions are paused for cross-chain security maintenance while transfers on Ethereum and L2s continue.
updates.current_state_zh: Threshold Network报告称，tBTC仍保持全额抵押，没有未经授权的铸造或损失，但为进行跨链安全维护，新存款、铸造和赎回已暂停，而以太坊和L2上的转账仍在继续。
updates.current_state_en: Threshold Network reported that tBTC remains fully collateralized with no unauthorized minting or losses, but new deposits, minting, and redemptions are paused for cross-chain security maintenance while transfers on Ethereum and L2s continue.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Threshold Network reported that tBTC remains fully collateralized with no unauthorized minting or losses, but new deposits, minting, and redemptions are paused for cross-chain security maintenance while transfers on Ethereum and L2s continue.

updates.title_zh: Threshold Network暂停tBTC跨链功能，称资产储备充足且未发生资金损失
updates.title_en: Threshold Network暂停tBTC跨链功能，称资产储备充足且未发生资金损失
updates.what_changed_zh: Threshold 将 tBTC 暂停归因于 Linux 内核漏洞 CVE-2026-98432，称所有 tBTC 节点运营商已完成服务器修补或暂时离线；另有一名运营商报告其基础设施发生与内核漏洞无关的安全事件，tBTC 节点用于支付交易费的以太坊账户被转走约 0.5 枚 ETH，但未发现签名密钥材料被访问。
updates.what_changed_en: Threshold attributed the tBTC pause to Linux kernel vulnerability CVE-2026-98432, saying all tBTC node operators patched or temporarily took nodes offline; one operator separately reported an unrelated infrastructure incident in which the Ethereum fee account for its tBTC node lost about 0.5 ETH, with no evidence of signing-key material access.
updates.current_state_zh: tBTC 铸造和赎回仍暂停，但资产仍有足额 BTC 支持，未发现未经授权的铸币、比特币转移或资金损失；节点运营商正在修补或离线，跨链桥将在安全维护完成且节点在已修补系统上恢复运行后重新开放。
updates.current_state_en: tBTC minting and redemption remain paused, but tBTC remains fully BTC-backed with no unauthorized minting, Bitcoin transfers, or fund loss found; node operators are patching or offline, and the bridge will reopen after security maintenance is completed and nodes resume on patched systems.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Threshold Network temporarily suspended tBTC minting and redemption over a Linux kernel vulnerability while confirming full BTC backing and no unauthorized minting or fund loss, with node operators patching or going offline.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Threshold Network temporarily suspended tBTC minting and redemption over a Linux kernel vulnerability while confirming full BTC backing and no unauthorized minting or fund loss, with node operators patching or going offline.
